author: Ezno
body: To all my friends over at walls, we all want /surface back! The command was a great command for Emerald+ ranks, and now it was removed for whatever reason. The Omega update was a great update, but the changes to donor perks wasn't so great. As an Emerald, I believe that paying $50 deserves some slack, including /surface. Below, please tell me if /surface is too op, or if it will ever be implemented once more.
